Om Kothari Institute vs University of Kota for commerce is again a private college against a public university. We have a BCom tuition figure only for Om Kothari, and no recent placement row for either side.

sections.heading: Om Kothari Institute vs University of Kota for BCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose University of Kota if you want a public university BCom in Kota and will confirm the current fee schedule on uok.ac.in, because that fee is missing from our table.
Choose Om Kothari Institute if you want a private-college BCom with a recorded tuition of ₹13,500 a year, after you check affiliation and the latest official notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: For Om Kothari Institute we hold ₹13,500 as BCom tuition for one year. It is a year figure, not a confirmed three-year total, and we have not multiplied it.
University of Kota has no BCom fee row here. Do not read a blank cell as zero fees. The official university notice is the only safe source for that side.
Because both campuses are in Kota, living costs are likely similar. The real comparison depends on the university's published fee, which we do not yet store.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no BCom placement row for 2020 or later on either side, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Many BCom graduates look at articles, accountancy exams, family businesses or local jobs. Ask both campuses for recent examples rather than waiting for a package table that we do not have.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. University of Kota will admit through its published undergraduate process; Om Kothari will follow its college or affiliating-university rules.
Check subject options such as accountancy or business studies, and the last date, on the official admissions pages before you fill a form.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are in Kota, Rajasthan, so a local student can visit them on the same day.
The public university and the private college will feel different in class size and campus life. Walk through the commerce department, not only the office, if you can.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick University of Kota if a public university BCom is what you want, and you have the current official fee in hand.
Pick Om Kothari Institute if the recorded ₹13,500 year tuition is clear for your budget and the college offers the commerce subjects you need.
Do not pick either college on placements from this page. Those cells are empty, and inventing a package would be wrong.
